name: my-rekkr - Unity Android FPS Source Project
desc_short: Retro FPS source project for Unity Android, with 36 maps, touch controls, saves, EN/AR settings and modern animation.
description:
A classic FPS, adapted for Android

my-rekkr is a Unity 2022.3 LTS Android source project hosting the Managed Doom C# engine and REKKR v1.17 game content. Explore four episodes and 36 maps with mobile touch movement, swipe aiming, configurable controls and widescreen presentation.

The project includes editable source, required game data, Unity project settings, Android build tools and English setup, customization and validation guides. Choose Classic, Modern or Custom animation, with weapon interpolation, recoil, camera effects and animated pickups. An optional GPU Remaster renderer is available on supported GPU classes.

Know what you are buying

This is a Doom-engine/data-driven project, not a prefab-only FPS construction kit. Unity and the Android toolchain are installed separately. The included build path creates APKs; a validated AAB/Google Play release pipeline is not included. Frame targets up to 120 Hz are settings, not a performance guarantee.

The gallery shows actual standalone classic-engine captures. Android touch overlays and GPU Remaster are not shown in these images. The demo links to the existing v0.8.0 APK. The marketplace archive has not been independently rebuilt in Unity; fresh engine regression tests passed, while physical-device, audible-audio and controller checks remain for the buyer's release validation.

Third-party licensing

The seller confirms separate permission for the commercial offering of this Android project. REKKR is credited to Revae and contributors; the original public CC BY-NC notices remain included alongside the seller's distribution note. Managed Doom and GPL-covered source remain under GPL-2.0. Other bundled materials retain their own licences. This is not a blanket proprietary relicensing or an unrestricted standalone-artwork resale pack.
features:
• Four REKKR episodes and 36 maps.
  • Touch movement and aiming, editable button layout and left-handed mode.
  • Gyro aiming, haptics, keyboard and gamepad input.
  • English and Arabic settings interface; original WAD menu artwork remains English.
  • Autosave, quick save/load, Continue, and save backup import/export.
  • Widescreen and 4:3 display modes; 60/90/120 Hz targets.
  • Graphics presets, dynamic resolution and visual effects.
  • Classic / Modern / Custom animation styles.
  • Optional GPU Remaster on supported GPU classes.
  • Source code, build tooling, English documentation and headless engine tests.
requirements:
• Unity 2022.3.62f3 with an eligible Unity licence.
  • Android Build Support, SDK platform 36, NDK r23b and JDK 11.
  • Android 7.0 / API 24 or newer; OpenGL ES 3-capable device.
  • C# and Unity knowledge for customization and production deployment.
  • A supported higher-performance GPU for optional Remaster rendering.
  • Your own signing key and device testing for distribution.
  • Optional: Python 3 for packaging tools and .NET SDK 10 for standalone engine tests.
instructions:
1. Extract the ZIP and read README.md, then docs/buyer/README.md.
  2. Open the folder containing Assets, Packages and ProjectSettings with Unity 2022.3.62f3.
  3. Allow import to finish, then select REKKR > Configure Project.
  4. Open Assets/Scenes/Main.unity and press Play.
  5. Follow docs/buyer/BUILDING.md to build an APK and configure your own signing.
  6. Use CUSTOMIZING.md for package identity, controls, language and visual settings.
  7. Read DISTRIBUTION.md and all component notices, and complete the VALIDATION.md device checklist before releasing your app.
